title: Eosinophil–neutrophil coupling does not establish incremental FeNO prediction across two NHANES cycles
abstract: A prespecified log-eosinophil × log-neutrophil interaction was tested beyond flexible marginal CBC counts and confounders. A weighted model developed in 4,023 NHANES 2007–2008 adults was frozen for 4,642 independently sampled 2009–2010 adults. Confirmation log-FeNO MSE decreased by 0.000273 (0.077% relative), but rescaled PSU-bootstrap 95% intervals included zero both conditionally and with source refits. Development group-cross-validation worsened. Unweighted and uncensored-target sensitivities reversed the gain. This is a negative incremental-representation test, not proof of absence of granulocyte physiology or a clinical biomarker. Offline clean reruns and author self-checks are included.
